Kabhalalocana
son of Kṛṣṇa Khaḍgarāya an. grandson of Govinda Kavibhūṣaṇa.
--Saṅgītacintāmaṇi. CPB. 6150-6151. K. 96. a. imitation of Gītagovinda; in the 2nd verse here a. salutes Caitanya.
--Gītamukunda or Gītāmṛta. K. 96. another imitation of Gītagovinda; in this a. salutes Gauracandra (v. 1), Caitanyacandra (v. 2) an. Vakreśvaraguru (v. 3).
See IHQ. XXV. p.. 96-101. The CPB. mss. ref. to above are now in the Nagpur Uni. collection.
